key_points: Salesforce announced a $25 billion accelerated share buyback, reducing diluted shares from ~962 M to ~821 M (~15% drop).
At Dreamforce 2026, CEO Marc Benioff unveiled AIforce, the company’s biggest product launch in years, positioning Salesforce against Microsoft/OpenAI via an Anthropic partnership.
Insider buying: director David Kirk purchased ~$1 million of CRM stock, signaling internal confidence.
One Wall Street firm reiterated a bullish thesis, projecting up to 70% upside based on the AI product’s potential to rewrite the CRM narrative.
Stock remains down over the past 12 months, but options pricing shows a wide 1‑year range ($152‑$368), indicating heightened uncertainty and potential for mean‑reversion.
